_comment: Every entry in thesis/chapters/references.bib, for Stage 4.5 Mode 2. Entries with an arXiv eprint or DOI resolve against that identifier; the rest go through a Crossref title search, which confirms a record exists but not the entry's other fields. Four entries carry author attestation: the author supplied a link to the paper where no machine-resolvable record was found. One of those (Samuel et al.) is upgraded to a DOI already resolved in the PR #68 corpus, so it is machine-verified rather than attested.
